newsitem.title: FRANCE: Monoprix, Casino agree to coop.
newsitem.headline: Monoprix, Casino agree to coop.

text.p: French retailers Monoprix and Casino have signed an agreement to cooperate in purchasing and logistics, the firms announced on Monday in a joint statement.

"Strengthened by their longtime friendly relationship, the two groups will demonstrate, through this new agreement, their goal of preserving and revitalising commerce in city centres," they said in the statement.
"Monoprix will thus be able to strengthen and develop its concept of 'city markets' offering clients quality products and friendly service at competitive prices," they said.
The agreement would not affect Casino's policy of pursuing affiliates, the statement said.
